You follow their glance toward freedom and send your shot to meet it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 8 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Gain one ordinary ranged weapon and one d8 ammunition bundle if absent; each Bulk 1. Check ammunition after every attack.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Drive a shot across its escape route. Requires ranged weapon and ammunition.

Weak
4 physical damage.
Standard
4 physical damage and push 1 square.
Strong
6 physical damage, push 1 square and Slowed 2.
